bug_description: BLOCK_RE required a mandatory newline before >>>>>>> REPLACE, so the natural no-blank-line empty-REPLACE form the prompt instructs for deletions could never match.
what_went_wrong: Regex used \n>{3,} which structurally rejected valid empty-REPLACE deletion blocks that had no blank line before the REPLACE marker.
fix_description: Changed \n>{3,} to \n?>{3,} so the newline before >>>>>>> REPLACE is optional.

bug_description: An RPM-throttled breakdown_phase failure set run status to failed, but cmd_dispatch only accepts planned/dispatching/stopped_on_failure, silently blocking resume.
what_went_wrong: check_tier2_ok guard lived outside the per-attempt retry loop and failures used status failed which cmd_dispatch refuses.
fix_description: Moved check_tier2_ok inside the existing per-attempt retry loop and used stopped_on_failure instead of failed.

bug_description: A checklist item verify-no-call-sites-remain grep passed trivially against dormant/commented files while live _CAPABILITY_FACTORIES registry entries remained.
what_went_wrong: Bare substring grep is not a ground-truth signal; matching dormant text masked still-live registry wiring.
fix_description: Assert against the registry dict (the one ground-truth signal) instead of a bare substring grep.
